def snap(f):
    seg=f.segmentation; dot=None;N=None;Y=None
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='r' and n['pixels']==1:
            b=n['boundary'][0]; dot=(b[0],b[1])
        if n['color']=='N' and 3<n['pixels']<10:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            N=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>20:
            cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; Y=max(cs)
    return dict(dot=dot,N=N,Yright=Y)

def snap(f):
    seg=f.segmentation; dot=None;N=None;Y=None
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='r' and n['pixels']==1:
            b=n['boundary'][0]; dot=(b[0],b[1])
        if n['color']=='N' and 3<n['pixels']<10:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            N=(min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
        if n['color']=='Y' and n['pixels']>20:
            cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; Y=max(cs)
    return dict(dot=dot,N=N,Yright=Y)
